title: Data Collection Facts Label
text:
Data Source Facts Label














Source Identity






Source name


Air Quality and Health Impacts




Domain/topic


Air Quality and Health




Source type


Government dataset











Collection Context






Collector/producer


NYC Department of Health and Mental Hygiene (DOHMH)




Original purpose


Examine the pollutants in the air and their effects on public health




Collection method


Sensors that measure pollution in air and hospital records




Record-creation event


Average air quality sensor reading and hospital records being summarized over a given time period











Observation and Scope






Unit of observation


A sensor reading of the average number of particles for either the whole year or a part of the year or summarized health data from hospital records over years




Population or objects represented


Particles in the air from different regions of New York city along with health outcomes from people of those areas




Time period covered


2005-2024




Geographic area coverage


New York City and different regions in it











Variables and Data Structure






Main variables/fields


Name, Measure, Measure Info, Geo Place Name, Time Period, Data Value




Data types included


ID, numerical, categorical, text, date




Direct measurements


Geo Place Name, Time Period, Start_Date, Data Value




Possible proxy variables


Data Value











Documentation






Documentation found

Stated collection details


The data comes from street-level monitors that measure ground-level exposures of air particles

title: Data Collection Facts Label
text:
Data Source Facts Label














Source Identity






Source name


Air Quality Purple Air Sensors




Domain/topic


DOEE’s Purple Air network in the District of Columbia




Source type


Government Collected Data Set





Collection Context






Collector/producer


DOEE




Original purpose


Takes Meteorological data to get an understanding of “hyper-local” air quality data.




Collection method


Uses sensor’s to detect PM2.5 and PM10




Record-creation event


When sensor is Logged





Observation and Scope






Unit of observation


Hourly measurements. Takes in PM2.5 and PM10 as well as meteorological measurements.




Population or objects represented


Atmosphere, Humidity




Time period covered


Period of 5 months from Febuary of 2025 to 2026




Geographic area coverage


District of Columbia





Variables and Data Structure






Main variables/fields


Humidity, Temperature, Pressure, Latitude, Longitude




Data types included


Location, Time, GPS, Sensors




Direct measurements


PM1, PM2_5 PM10




Possible proxy variables


Air flow, WInd direction, Weather.
